headline: Third quiet day running as the index drifts
body: No scored news again. Endings drifted by a hundredth of a point as earlier events faded, and Horizon Balance eased to -4.92. The top three are unchanged: Enslaved God 41.69, Conquerors 27.84, Self-Destruction 25.91.
movers_note: No ending moved by a tenth of a point; only fading earlier events, at 0.01 each.
